messages:
Maya (AE): quick thread — AtlasCorp wants a 3-week POC to validate contract Q&A + clause extraction. they asked for clear acceptance criteria, a security checklist (SOC2/KMS), and a pricing sketch. can we scope?
Jon (SE): tagging @Tariq @Dee. my initial read: acceptance = 90% top-1 on golden extract tasks, p95 <200ms for standard queries, and zero PII leakage in outputs. recommend lightweight eval harness + redaction vector tests + regression gates.
AtlasCorp (Customer): must have automated redaction for tax IDs and bank numbers, plus an audit trail for every query. SOC2 evidence required. legal wants questionnaire done by Thu.
Tariq (Solutions): golden set plan: 150 core Q&A (factual/extract), 40 ambiguous/negatives, 25 redaction probes, and 20 rerank scenarios. we'll anonymize with our pipeline. propose CSV schema: uid, prompt, expected, check_type
Dee (Sales Eng): clarify: do they prefer Dedicated (reserved) or Hosted? they asked for committed pricing vs payg.
Maya (AE): AtlasCorp is leaning reserved if we hit latency SLOs. please prepare 2 commercial options.
Jon (SE): eval harness sketch:
- ingest -> OCR + normalize -> metadata tagging
- seed golden CSV (uid,prompt,expected,check_type,notes)
- batch eval: exact/span F1 + embedding cos sim + rerank NDCG@3
- regression gate: fail if exact drops >7% OR semantic drops >4%

example row:
```
uid:AC-0007,prompt:"Which party pays termination fees?",expected:"Vendor pays fees",check_type:exact
```

scoring rules (pseudo):
```
if exact_match: score=1.0
elif span_f1>0.8: score=0.75
elif emb_sim>0.9: score=0.6
else: score=0.0
```

Tariq (Solutions): timeline estimate: day0-1 ingest + security kick; day2-4 label 100 seed items with SME; day5 run baseline + initial tuning; day6-7 acceptance runs + final report. total ~8 working days.
Zoe (Product): include caching test (KV) and cold-start throughput sampling. caching helps p95 but can hide regression; log cache hit rates in scorecard.
infra-bot: note: for Private deployment VPC peering required; estimated network lead time 48-72h. Hosted path supports CMEK (customer-managed encrypt keys) and ephemeral file system.
AtlasCorp (Customer): thanks. also want an evidence folder for redaction tests so legal can see before we go live.
Jon (SE): redaction flow: ingest -> deterministic redactor (regex + ML heuristics) -> masked input -> model. for Hosted we'll keep originals encrypted with customer KMS and auto-delete after 24h unless Private. we will produce a redaction-proof report for each run.
Dee (Sales Eng): pricing sketches (rough):
- Hosted trial: no commit, PAYG ~ $0.02 /k tokens + eval hours (good for 3-week POC).
- Reserved medium: $8k/mo commit -> lower per-token ops and priority capacity (SLA baseline).
I'll draft commercial one-pager and run by legal.
Maya (AE): acceptance checklist proposal:
- Golden top-1 >= 90%
- p95 latency <200ms on sample load
- redaction tests: 0 leaking tokens in outputs
- audit trail available for 100% of eval queries
- any "needs on-prem" security flags called out

Tariq (Solutions): action items: @Tariq create goldens template + 40 initial pairs by Tue; @AtlasCorp share 200 sample contracts by EOD today; @Dee deliver pricing one-pager by Wed. Jon will supply harness adapter.
AtlasCorp (Customer): uploading sample contracts now to the secure bucket. will fill what we can in the questionnaire.
Maya (AE): I'll draft a short SOW and SLA for the POC and attach to the pitch.
Zoe (Product): small ask  include a prompt-version log with every eval snapshot so we can track prompt changes across runs.
Jon (SE): will snapshot prompts + embeddings and record them in the harness metadata. also will include NDCG logs for reranking tasks.
infra-bot: reminder: network ticket if VPC peering requested. add 2 business days.
legal-bot: SOC2 Type II summary and questionnaire template uploaded: https://redwood.example/soc2/AtlasCorp-pack and https://redwood.example/security/questionnaire-v3.docx
Maya (AE): solid. next sync Friday AM. closing thread, will reopen if blockers pop up. :rocket:
